Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Traditional Detailed Diamond Rug, 8' x 10', Rust
Colors: Rust
Materials: stone
Pile: 100% Polypropylene, Backing: 100% Jute Imported Warm up those wood floors with this area rug. Cozy rust colors bring a modern appeal to the classic trellis design that blends easily with your existing styles. Classic style and comfort Machine made in Turkey. 100% polypropylene Ideal for high traffic areas. 8' x 10' Pairs with a rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow up to a week for synthetic fibers to settle
